caption: The flow starts with a supposed universal cloner, fixes its action on |0⟩ and |1⟩, then applies linearity to a superposition. The final state is not a clone because its inner product with the required clone is not 1.

spec.title: Why a universal cloner fails
spec.aria: A downward flowchart starting from a supposed universal cloner, showing its action on 0 and 1, then linearity on a superposition, ending in a state that is not a clone.
